svg.title: MIRA Reference Architecture - Overview
svg.desc: Voice requests enter an AKS gateway, which uses a Foundry-native AI Gateway with separate WebSocket voice and HTTP operator model routes. Direct ClusterIP routing and downstream tools bypass APIM. Reviewed procedures, operational grounding, and workplace services are separate authorities. Operational grounding uses a Foundry tool call, a server tool runner, and one of two Fabric execution modes. GitHub publishes immutable snapshots to Azure Managed Redis. Redis Pub/Sub hints and startup/periodic reconciliation drive validated atomic activation in running routers, without image rebuilds. Solid two-way arrows carry queries and results; dashed amber arrows publish approved content asynchronously.
svg.text: OVERVIEW | Voice operations, trusted sources, governed content
Direct ClusterIP endpoint; model-only AI Gateway
Voice / IQ web adapter: execute tool calls and return grounded results
6 Select one: Direct DAX OR Fabric IQ Data Agent
Procedure evidence and live operational queries retain separate authority.
APIM Basic v2 | Authentication, routing, request metrics
WebSocket API: voice Entra identity + model restriction
Handshake governance; original bearer; full-duplex audio
HTTP project API: router routing / synthesis model calls
Server-side scoped subscription; APIM MI → backend
Work IQ / Microsoft 365: people, messages, collaboration
Graph Shifts: live published on-call roster
Fixed delegated identity, not an identity per radio speaker
Direct hosted-agent / tool route; outside APIM
Immutable corpus + curation snapshots | CAS active revision pointer
Lossy Redis Pub/Sub hints; startup / periodic reconciliation required
TLS | Runtime: read-only managed identity | Publisher: separate writer
No per-query Redis calls; snapshots + control only
Direct Fabric DAX: server managed identity
Local procedure evidence: no operator-model call. Spoken answers still use Realtime through AI Gateway.
Freshness: active revision + source_checked_at + activated_at in runtime status / telemetry, not pod annotations.
Transport outage: bounded approved use within expiry + refresh lease. Invalid or withdrawn source: fail closed.
Hashes + scope + source SHA + review / expiry
Redis holds no audio, prompts, private M365 content or Fabric results. ACR images remain a separate code-release path.
